scope: CPU-only noTC global-bias conversion, shared training condition, strict checkpoint, context-access rejection and actual independent repo inference subprocess with fake backbone. Not real MusicFM/GPU/H3 deployment acceptance.
limitations: global_context_bias is trainable and initialized from the old context_projection.bias; the old context_projection.weight is absent. This preserves old ZERO-context predictions, not old real-TC-context predictions.
The new student only receives waveforms and a learned shared bias. Teacher hidden tokens/lengths are supervision only; images remain downstream H3 visual-VAE conditioning, not student adapter inputs.
No real MusicFM backbone is loaded, no GPU training is launched, no sampler/inference deployment tree is modified.

Repo inference worker now supports music-only waveform input. This reproduction launches the actual repo worker main in a fresh Python process while injecting a fake CPU backbone and CPU device adapters; output tail/length/policy are checked exactly. Actual MusicFM/GPU acceptance remains separate. Running diff deployment trees remain frozen.
width256 output_norm LayerNorm and complete trainable raw_output are retained; affine-difference rank is at most255, and full fixed-basis reachability is not claimed.
The legacy CPU report remains immutable. Its exact test code is replayed against this explicitly SHA-bound new source version to verify compatibility.

    backend = 'musicfm'
    hidden_size = 1024
    sample_rate = 24000

        super().__init__()
        self.calls = 0
        self.model = nn.Module()
        self.model.conv = nn.Linear(1,1024)
        self.model.conformer = nn.Module()
        self.model.conformer.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(1024)
        self.model.conformer.layers = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(1024,1024)])
        self.model.other = nn.Linear(2,2)
        self.model.stat = {'melspec_2048_mean':-5.,'melspec_2048_std':2.}
        self.model.register_buffer('running',torch.ones(2))
    def metadata(self):
        return {'backend':'musicfm','sample_rate':24000,'hidden_size':1024,'model_path':'fake'}
    def forward(self,wave):
        self.calls += 1
        x = wave[:,:16].reshape(len(wave),4,4).mean(-1,keepdim=True)
        x = self.model.conv(x)
        x = self.model.conformer.layer_norm(x)
        return self.model.conformer.layers[0](x)
